cues: Plane polarized light of amplitude A meets an analyser whose axis is at an angle theta to the vibrations.
A cos theta, along the axis, gets through.
A sine theta, across the axis, is absorbed.
text: Now Malus's law. Plane polarized light of amplitude A meets an analyser whose axis is at an angle theta to the vibrations. Split A into two parts. A cos theta, along the axis, gets through. A sine theta, across the axis, is absorbed.
